verdict.summary: Round 3 remains correct and complete. The server feature forwards `dp-planner` to `sparq-engine` and adds it only to the server binary's default feature set, preserving the engine library's lean default and the documented `--no-default-features` opt-out. The integration test uses a real connected three-pattern BGP, exercises the compiled-in default path and explicit greedy opt-out, checks concrete nonempty answers, and verifies scoped state restoration. Its compile-time reference detects broken feature forwarding, while its comments accurately disclose that removing the feature from the server default would compile the gated file to zero tests.
